trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx puts the whole journey at roughly 200 hours and difficulty 4/10, with the 100% completion checklist as the longest single job. Work through the three roadmap stages in this guide and tick trophies off as you go; this one takes care of itself at the end.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The longest trophy in the game. After the story, the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — and progress you made during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx notes the list is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. The parts that do demand everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Expect around 100 hours of cleanup after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you can mix them freely — under-the-bridges runs are the quickest. Track your count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find the spots on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types, which you can view under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map, and you will do one of each almost by accident while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

The ranges also feed the 100% checklist, which requires all of them, so this pops during the Stage 2 cleanup.

trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 by interacting with the controllers; the fourth is found at arcade machines around the world. To complete one you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever game you like best.

trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. It stays available after the story. trophies.guide: Kenton's questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams. He calls you, then appears with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his quest sets — after each set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story but comes back in Chapters 2–3, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks are side quests found in the open world, but only certain questlines count — PowerPyx warns that the named quest-givers (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do not count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street races and Pilot Pete's delivery runs, with more still being found. All of them stay available in free-roam after the story, and you can watch your count on the trophy tracker. Work through the stranger icons on the map and this pops once your eighth strand is done.

trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City — he marks some on the map, and you can steal the rest off the street; scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on his list. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs around Vice City: go to them and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at a spot counts as +2. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The catch, and the one potentially missable trophy in the game: a first meditation at Jason's house can only be done in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is actually required for the trophy, since it is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest — but do it anyway while you can. You cannot do the last meditation until both characters are playable together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do that quest and Bret starts marking hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker, and one clean shot leaves a kill in pristine condition. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100%. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so keep working Bret's quests and it will come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

PowerPyx counts more than 100 scannable spots split across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, so any 100 will do — scan whatever you pass. Most complete themselves while you chase the other trophies; when you are near the end, pick the easiest ones you have left and finish them off.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level by causing carnage, then escape the red heat zone; a fast sports bike and cutting through traffic works well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a handy escape route because the helicopter cannot follow you there. The trophy pops once you drive out of the heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Do this after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Hit 3 robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time, keeping the flashing wanted level rather than dropping it. Wear body armor, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and loot a couple of items in each shop. PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3; the pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and you only need to discover 100 of them. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — you do not need to drive it. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. Track your total under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model scans, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is triggered with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak points are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must drop 5 enemies inside one use, so set it up first — eat or drink to buff focus, take Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window, wear body armor, and line up a group of enemies before you trigger it. PowerPyx suggests criminals at gang operations, with a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, and notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. PowerPyx points to the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head for the boarding bridge, and use the stairs by the bridge to walk straight into the plane. Get in the cockpit, reverse to the strip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb in, fire at some enemies, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets the alarm off — then find the safe code on a note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash — bring your partner, since you cannot carry it all alone. After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000 each) to mark more vans; each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way there — and a single vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that opens bank vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. If you want it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs — then escape the red heat radius. You need all 8 large bank jobs for 100% anyway, so this comes free during the cleanup.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

PowerPyx has a dedicated guide on unfogging the map fast and which plane to use. PSN tracks 52 areas for this trophy, so keep flying until the counter is complete.

You only need to rob one operation per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way there. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops once you have had your drink with the view.

trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only that blue Banshee counts — no other car will do — and the pop is slightly delayed until you have driven a little way down the street. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick the items up — and if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can go back for what is left. Nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the character, then Strength. Raise it by working out — buy a gym membership and always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle to call them), because while one character trains, the other finishes their training too, doubling your progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City under Map, then Activities.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that shift your criminal profile — you can see the count by opening this trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx recommends turning on criminal-profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy robberies, clean escapes, knocking enemies out, killing, and worse all feed the counter in different directions, from Professional up to Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, so do not lean on mass violence just to farm it. It builds passively while you chase the other trophies; if it is the last one left, running over pedestrians and police with a car fills it fast.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.unconfirmed: The unlock method is currently unknown; the Payday Loans link is only a belief, not a confirmed fact.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. PowerPyx reports it on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and you must go alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO in the sky; approach it and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City streets or Ocean Beach give you the most targets in the shortest time — keep moving, keep kicking, and the trophy pops once the tenth pedestrian goes down inside the minute.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and payday loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip, and bank vaults alone can hand you up to $205,000 in a few minutes once they open in Chapter 4. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for 100%.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — it counts cumulatively, so every purchase adds up. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. PowerPyx counts the shops as 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. You will be most of the way there just from gearing up for the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — there are 4 more garages tied to the story, but only the 8 you buy count here. They cost $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone; buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes), then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage — he only takes vehicles without trackers at first, and from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
